title: Page 213
transc:
Wash'n June 18 / 64
Bickford White House
Sheldon at F has copy of
your cipher except the arbitrary words
send anything you may have to
him period he will for ward
to dover in another cipher end
do you know if hunt here
is with cherry den period send
all information you get about them
T. T. Eckert


Ft Monroe June 18 / 64
Maj. Eckert Washington
Add to Forsyth's message after walker ton last night
zebra he will probably move towards White House peru
he can hear from his sheaf vincent who came
through with me zodiac then insert the following to
cherry den after virgin night closed the contest violet
down to virgin The panama engagement of the flood
violet I found on examination torch polka that there 
was not a sufficiency of olive left to continue
the engagement unity The next day pekin trains of
cars also came down to where we re engaged
with the Rose zebra The wicks of prisoners &
citizens were that Picketts old quincy or a portion
of it was coming to prevent the taking of
China I therefore during the night and next morning
with drew my pontiac tower torrent Anna peasant carpenter
